name: AI, IoT & Robotics Innovation Workshop
description:
AI, IoT & ROBOTICS INNOVATION WORKSHOP

A hands-on technical workshop exploring Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Robotics, Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, and IoT Device Forensics through practical learning and real-world applications.

What You'll Gain:
- Hands-on exposure to emerging technologies
- Practical understanding of AI, ML, IoT & Robotics
- Introduction to Cloud Computing and connected systems
- Insights into IoT Device Forensics
- Learn how intelligent and automated systems are designed
- Work with real-world applications and problem-solving approaches
- Interact with technology and explore industry-relevant concepts
- Participation Certificate for all registered participants

Certificate of Participation will be provided to all participants upon successful completion of the workshop.

name: BGMI WARZONE
description: Assemble your squad in BGMI and battle it out to become the champions of NIT Durgapur

name: VALORANT VIRTUAL REALM CARNIVAL
description: Bring your squad, trust your instincts and put everything to be victorious.

name: WEB3 WORKSHOP
description: Step into the decentralized future with Team Aavishkar's Web3 Workshop at Aarohan '26-27! Join us at NIT Durgapur for a hands-on introduction to blockchain and the technologies shaping the new internet. Bring your curiosity and get started!

name: CODE CRACKER
description: Hello Programmers! Codecracker returns to Aarohan. Test your logic and speed against a gauntlet of mind-bending algorithmic challenges. Crush the execution constraints, climb the live leaderboard, and claim ultimate glory!

name: MAZEMERIZE
description: Can you find the way out? Step into MAZEMERIZE, a high-stakes maze where memory meets strategy. You'll get a chance to observe the path, but once inside, every second counts and one wrong move could leave you lost. Think fast and trust your instincts. The maze is waiting—are you ready?

name: SKY N' SPY
description: Take your curiosity to the skies with Sky N' Spy: The Drone Technology Workshop! Join this 2-day, beginner-friendly session to discover exactly how drones work, fly, and are controlled through hands-on experience. Gain practical exposure, earn a certificate, and grab exclusive goodies.

name: GAME OF THRONES
description:
Enter the realm of Game of Throne at Aarohan 2026! In this ultimate test of wit, alliances, and power plays, intellect and strategy crown supremacy. Command your house through challenges of logic and precision to outthink, outmaneuver, and outlast the competition.

Think sharper. Play bolder. Rule fearlessly.

name: INVICTUS
description:
Step into INVICTUS: The Quantum Synergy at Aarohan 2026! Transform abstract ideas into tangible marvels in this ultimate test of engineering excellence across the Chemical, Mechanical, and Civil domains. Push your logic, precision, and creativity to new frontiers and redefine the boundaries of design.

Think sharper. Build stronger. Innovate fearlessly.

name: ROBOLIGA
description:
OVERRIDE the limits. Command the bots.

ROBOLOGIA is here! Outsmart your opponent, master every move and put your skills to the test.

name: DEATH NOTE
description: DEATH NOTE is back! Step into a world where nothing is quite what it seems and every tiny detail could change the story. Read between the lines, question everything, and trust no one—the truth might be hiding right in front of you. The mystery is yours to unfold.
